purpose: Bootstrap an auditable V5.2 forward-PIT evidence path using an official Premier League lineup page plus one exact-fixture public odds payload. R44A records collector first-observed timestamps and payload hashes, audits H/D/A, Asian and multi-line OU inside one response, then freezes bookmaker-specific visible quote fields and target freeze-window identity. It does not create a formal market snapshot or predictive claim.

fixture.kickoff_timezone_provenance: PremierLeague.com official fixture identity previously captured in R39R/R39S; UTC conversion from 20:00 BST

exact_fixture_payload.role_separation_rule: Audit three role-specific regions inside one exact-fixture payload. HDA must be bounded before the first handicap table; Asian must be the first handicap table containing 0:0; OU must be the second handicap table containing 0.5 through 5.5. Do not infer OU lines from the Asian region.

structured_extraction.persistence_semantics: IMMUTABLE_ARTIFACT_PER_OBSERVATION; target-window coverage is proven only by distinct successful run/artifact identities

market_source.independence_rule: Treat Infobetting as one provider group. Listed bookmaker quote rows may be extracted for field identity but are not counted as independent provider groups in R44A.

stage1_success_semantics.PASS_R44A_SOURCE_FEASIBILITY_NOT_FORMAL_: Official lineup state is captured pre-kickoff and the exact Infobetting fixture page is captured for the same fixture. This remains a broad source-feasibility receipt.
stage1_success_semantics.PASS_R44A_EXACT_FIXTURE_MULTI_MARKET_COV: One pre-kickoff exact-fixture payload is hash-verified and independently passes H/D/A, Asian and multi-line OU role audits without cross-role inference.
stage1_success_semantics.PASS_R44A_STRUCTURED_BOOKMAKER_QUOTES_NO: The hashed exact-fixture payload yields frozen bookmaker-specific H/D/A, Asian and required OU quote pairs under the preregistered field identity contract; no source-summary inconsistency is detected.
stage1_success_semantics.PASS_R44A_STRUCTURED_BOOKMAKER_QUOTES_WI: Bookmaker-specific quote rows are structurally frozen and pass coverage gates, while one or more aggregator summary Max fields differ from visible bookmaker-row maxima. Bookmaker rows remain primary and the mismatch is retained as a warning, not silently reconciled.
stage1_success_semantics.STOP_R44A_MARKET_DISCOVERY_NO_MATCH: Official lineup evidence may be valid, but no qualifying exact fixture market page was captured inside the frozen request budget. Stop before any label/model work.
